Then you write the meaning, write the Korean word and write your own sentence, finish with a unit checkup, and mark your work with the answer key at the back. about.en: 150 idioms, 150 proverbs and 149 four-character idioms that Korean speakers use all the time, 15 per unit in 30 units. Each expression has its meaning in English and Korean, a literal translation, a similar English saying when there is one, and two example sentences with translation. Then you write the meaning, finish the proverb and write your own sentence, finish with a unit checkup (match the meanings, fill the dialog blanks), and mark your work with the answer key at the back. A QR code opens a free match game for the same expressions.
